overview_description.description: Block Renovation is a renovation platform that combines architect-grade design, construction labor, and materials into a streamlined renovation experience. Block’s mission is to give homeowners a better way to improve the spaces they live in, and to give contractors a better way to work. Founded by Koda Wang and Luke Sherwin, Block simplifies a complex and convoluted process and delivers an intuitive experience for completing a beautiful home renovation.

about_short_description.short_description: Block Renovation provides a platform for homeowners, designers, and contractors for home renovation projects.

product.name: Renovation Planning Tool
product.description: A free online tool that allows homeowners to design renovation spaces, estimate costs, and visualize materials in real time.

product.name: Contractor Matching Service
product.description: A service that connects homeowners with up to three vetted local contractors suited to their renovation project needs.

product.name: Renovation Consultant Support
product.description: A free dedicated expert service that assists homeowners in navigating proposals, timelines, and contractor selection during renovations.

product.name: Block Protections
product.description: A set of protections including price assurance, progress-based payments, workmanship warranty, and ongoing support to safeguard renovation projects.

product.name: AI Bathroom Remodel Planner
product.description: A free AI-powered tool that helps homeowners design bathroom remodels, visualize changes, and receive real-time cost estimates.
